name: Stamp approve
oneLiner: a real hardboard clipboard with a typed form slides onto a walnut desk on twos, a wooden rubber stamp comes down out of the lens, slams, and lifts away to leave a green APPROVED imprint pressed into the paper
say: when the speaker says something got the yes ('and it got approved', 'that is a green light', 'verified'): the stamp slams on the word and the green imprint holds while they keep talking
